_comment: AI 出图规格的唯一数据源（docs/art-prompts.md 与 docs/art/*.png 都由它生成）。
grid = 游戏里的逻辑像素尺寸；size = 建议生成尺寸（grid × 32）；color 取自 data 里的配置色。
subject 只写主体，风格块由 src/art-preview.ts 的 STYLE 统一拼在前面。

hero.label: 英雄 · 游侠
hero.subject: a lean ranger in a hooded cloak, cyan-trimmed leather armor, small crossbow, short cape, hood shadowing the upper face, glowing cyan eyes, agile stance
hero.frames: idle standing / mid-stride walking / flinching backwards when hit / collapsed on the ground after death

grunt.label: 杂兵
grunt.subject: a small round-bodied imp with two short horns, angry white eyes, stubby legs, tiny claws, crimson red skin, cute but aggressive
grunt.frames: idle / walking with legs apart / squashed body flinching / flattened pancake on the ground

runner.label: 疾行者
runner.subject: a lean elongated hound-like creature, long pointed ears, thin spiky back, no arms, orange fur, fast and twitchy, glowing eyes
runner.frames: idle / sprinting with legs stretched / recoiling / splattered flat

brute.label: 重装（精英）
brute.subject: a hulking armored ogre, huge pauldrons, tiny head with heavy brows, thick arms, short legs, purple plate armor with dark rivets, gold belt buckle, slow and heavy
brute.frames: idle / heavy stomping step / arm raised flinching / crushed flat on the ground

warden.label: 守关者（Boss）
warden.subject: a towering horned warden, long curved horns, hollow glowing eyes, cracked stone armor, gold rivets, tattered waist cloth, imposing boss silhouette
warden.frames: idle / slow menacing step / roaring while being hit / collapsing into rubble

summon_economy.label: 召唤物 · 经济怪
summon_economy.subject: a round coin-shaped slime with a golden coin embedded in its forehead, no horns, friendly dumb expression, faint gold ring around it
summon_economy.frames: idle / bobbing walk / flinching / collapsing into a puff

summon_xp.label: 召唤物 · 经验怪
summon_xp.subject: a floating green flame wisp with a small book-like charm, no horns, calm expression, faint green ring around it
summon_xp.frames: idle / bobbing walk / flinching / collapsing into a puff

summon_essence.label: 召唤物 · 精粹怪
summon_essence.subject: a floating single-eyed orb with a gemstone core, no horns, unsettling stare, faint violet ring around it
summon_essence.frames: idle / bobbing walk / flinching / collapsing into a puff

pickup.label: 资源球（运行时染色）
pickup.subject: a small cut gemstone, isometric diamond shape, bright white core with a bright edge, minimal detail, readable at very small size

bullet.label: 子弹（朝右）
bullet.subject: a tiny glowing dart pointing right, warm yellow core, near-black outline
bullet.frames: single frame only, must face right (+X)
